title: Auto Replanting
description: Automatically replants crops and saplings when harvested.
body:
**Auto Replant** is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that automatically replants fully-grown crops when you harvest them.
No menus, no configuration, no extra steps — just play as usual and enjoy smoother farming.

When you break a mature crop (wheat, carrots, potatoes, etc.), the mod instantly places the same seed back into the soil, allowing you to keep farming without stopping to replant every block manually.

This mod keeps the vanilla gameplay feel while removing one of the most repetitive tasks in survival worlds. Perfect for large farms, SMP servers, or players who want a cleaner and more efficient farming experience.

Stop replanting crops by hand — let the mod do it for you! 🌾
